about: The topics of the wiki, in the order of its topic bar: the one list. pages.py and llms.py read it, app.js reads the topic bar of the page, and test_publish.py checks that the New offer form and the store agree with it. A topic of the research schema needs a line here before a publish with records in it.

topics.name: Storage
topics.description: Where bytes can live: object storage, drives, registries, academic repositories, hosts used as storage.

topics.name: Compute
topics.description: Machines, sandboxes, notebooks, GPU time, platform hosts and how long each runs before it is reaped.

topics.name: Inference
topics.description: Model APIs that answer a completion request, keyless or behind a free key.

topics.name: Egress and tunnels
topics.description: Ways to get traffic out or a service in: tunnels, relays, IPv6 brokers, UDP forwards.

topics.name: IP and proxies
topics.description: Exit addresses: proxy lists, VPN exits, address sources and what the upstream sees.

topics.name: Crawling
topics.description: Crawl, search, reader and unblocker APIs for reading the web at scale.

topics.name: Debrid
topics.description: Multi-hosters, premium-link generators, usenet and retrieval services.

topics.name: Netdisk and pan
topics.description: Pan drives and public AList/OpenList instances, and whether they mount.

topics.name: Databases and KV
topics.description: Hosted databases, vector stores and key-value stores.

topics.name: Email
topics.description: Sending, receiving, forwarding and inbox APIs.

topics.name: Domains and DNS
topics.description: Managed DNS, free domains and certificate authorities.

topics.name: CI runners
topics.description: Hosted CI runners and registries, and what they will run.

topics.name: Developer services
topics.description: Monitoring, error tracking, analytics, scheduled jobs, queues, realtime and authentication services.

topics.name: Data APIs
topics.description: Data APIs with free calls, and their bulk downloads: maps, IP location, markets, weather, news and open data.

topics.name: Coding subscriptions
topics.description: Coding-agent subscriptions and their price per unit of work.
